# Code of conduct

8Bit Agents follows the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

In short: be kind and patient, welcome newcomers, criticise ideas rather than people, and leave out
harassment, insults and personal attacks of any kind. This applies in issues, pull requests,
discussions and anywhere else you represent the project.

To report behaviour that breaks these rules, email ghxstbytestudios@gmail.com. Reports are kept private.
Maintainers may edit or remove comments, and warn or ban anyone who breaks the rules, as the Covenant
describes.
